newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot's Calvet may stand in French election.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot's Calvet may stand in French election.

text.p: Jacques Calvet, chairman of French automobile giant Peugeot-Citroen, was quoted in a newspaper interview on Saturday as saying he might stand in the country's current general election.

Replying on the record for the first time to multiple reports saying he would launch a political career, Calvet told the daily Le Figaro, "We have until Sunday night midnight (closing date for candidacies) to decide. I will be a candidate if I think it's the best way to keep this constituency (at Levallois in the Paris suburbs) for the majority."
He said that if he stood, it would be as a pro-government independent.
Calvet was non-committal when asked about reports that Prime Minister Alain Juppe had told him he would get a cabinet post if elected.
